log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed 2 national (quick, morning/afternoon). Strategy: national only is safe (no source leak). Pool must stay >100k. Watch press conferences every 3 days. Consider adding sources cautiously.

Press conference after day 3 will show the pool; if still 10M, consider adding sources cautiously, one at a time. Routine timing: keep deaths only in free blocks (morning/afternoon), never more than 2 in busy blocks.

Day4: pool still 10M after day 3 with national-only kills. Adding one source at a time to learn L's abilities. Day4 test: add regional (1 kill) plus national. Keep all deaths in free blocks (morning/afternoon). Check press conference after day 6 for pool change; if pool drops near 100k, stop that source.

Day5: continuing cautious testing. Pool was 10M after day 3 (national-only kills in free blocks). Day4 added regional. Next press conference after day 6. Keep all kills quick in morning/afternoon (my free blocks). Today: national x2 plus regional again to see whether regional reveals region; no web/police/foreign yet. If pool after day 6 drops sharply (e.g. to 1M), regional is visible to L; then stop regional. If still 10M, regional is safe and add web next.

Keep all kills quick in morning/afternoon (my free blocks), never evening/night.

Pool 1M after day 6 so regional IS visible to L (pool is Kita only). Never kill regional again. Pool is 1M, need to stay above 100k. Timing not shown to be visible, but keep quick kills in morning/afternoon only. Police (2%) and foreign (4%) would be fatal if visible: never use them. Web (30%) would take the pool to about 300k, which is risky, so skipped. Currently only killing 2 national per day, morning and afternoon.
